new_value: Nightly fuzz job now executes the standalone parser harnesses (R-APPC-013) with the sanitizers.conf ASAN/UBSAN policy applied to the host binaries (R-APPC-009). .github/workflows/fuzz.yml zephyr-fuzz job (schedule-only, id retained): replaced the dead 'west twister -T lichen/tests/fuzz' invocation + its entire west/zephyr scaffold (twister discovers zero tests — lichen/tests/fuzz is a standalone host CMake project, not a Zephyr app; finding confirmed by review) with: apt install clang cmake ninja-build; cmake lichen/tests/fuzz -B build-fuzz -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DLICHEN_FUZZ_FORCE_STANDALONE=ON; cmake --build; ./fuzz_frame 50000 $FUZZ_SEED, fuzz_schnorr48, fuzz_schc (timeout 15 min); failure() artifact upload of build-fuzz/ for reproduction. FUZZ_SEED=github.run_number (logged in step output): nightly exploration varies, every failure is replayable with the logged seed. CMakeLists: new LICHEN_FUZZ_FORCE_STANDALONE option — REQUIRED for correctness because on ubuntu-latest the libFuzzer runtime ships in libclang-rt-dev (same package as the sanitizer runtime), so the HAVE_LIBFUZZER probe succeeds and libFuzzer binaries would treat '50000 42' as corpus dirs and run unbounded into the timeout (found by review round 1; round 2 corroborated via apt package analysis). Also from review: FUZZ_FLAGS now includes -fno-sanitize-recover=all in both branches (matching lichen_sanitizers.cmake/test_common.cmake convention) so UBSan violations abort instead of logging-and-continuing. Verification: exact job commands replicated locally on heft (clang 20.1.8) with forced-standalone configure (build log confirms 'libFuzzer not available: building standalone fuzzers'), all three harnesses exit 0 at 50k iterations under ASan/UBSan with varied seeds (42/1234/777); YAML parses; no dangling west/zephyr references in any workflow (grep-verified by review). Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS (argv contract, paths, artifact scope, -Wno-nullability-completeness safe on Linux clang), security found the -fno-sanitize-recover gap (fixed), supply-chain improved (3 apt packages vs pip west+zephyr requirements), edge-cases clean (no dangling refs, artifact names unique, if-no-files-found warn non-fatal). Informational (not filed, noted): PR-gated smoke fuzz run (~5k iterations on parser-source changes) remains a cheap optional future enhancement; committed stale Mac build cache in lichen/tests/fuzz/build + .o files predates this bead and is outside its scope.
